_about: Controlled vocabulary. The validator rejects any value not listed here, so filters on the site stay consistent. Add new values here first.

_verificationNotes.search-confirmed: The program and this URL appeared in web searches on checkedOn.
_verificationNotes.link-checked: The page loaded for the automated checker on checkedOn.
_verificationNotes.blocked: The site refused the automated checker (bot protection). Usually fine in a browser; open it by hand.
_verificationNotes.broken: The page is gone or the host does not resolve. Needs a new URL.

_identityNotes.underrepresented: Programs that define their own underrepresented groups. Several changed or dropped race-based criteria in 2025–26; read the statusNote and the program's current eligibility page.
_identityNotes.us-citizen: Most federal programs require U.S. citizenship.
_identityNotes.international: Needs CPT or OPT work authorization for internships; see rutgers-global-isss.
